entries.title: Official pool enables complete v1; role checks challenge the cheap receivers
entries.question: Can the four-player core support a complete roster, and which assumptions are weakest?
entries.why_it_matters: A legal roster enables meaningful package review; prior partials cannot be relabelled complete retroactively.
findings: Official group153728 and salary export now verify the same11-game Sunday pool; the earlier anticipated window did not change.
All four Tuesday picks match their official prices. Five additions total$24,300, yielding$49,200/$800left.
Cooper's70%reportedroute share challenges a full-time role; primary film article says Wilson drew attention on two major plays. No permanent displacement claim.
Provider projection page now captions14games Thu–Mon, even though titled main slate; no estimates imported into this11-game record.
Ferguson screened at$4,100 but fresh Monday box has0catches/1target; prefer Taylor's documented receiving involvement at$3,300 while retaining Jets concentration risk.

Week7 slate completed; fresh Jets box agrees with archived key scoring inputs. No new settled-platform evidence or material Week6/7 correction established; existing provisional totals remain unchanged.
entries.interpretation: Retain the core; fill with Brown, Flowers, Taylor, Concepcion and Jets. Keep800unspent rather than force weaker evidence. Omar's participation evidence argues for restraint, while Ferguson's one target weakens the screened TE alternative.
alternatives: Brown costs200more than Braelon, trading unresolved Hall dependence for a documented receiving component; Brown still shares scoring work.
Ferguson costs800more than Taylor with poorer latest target evidence. One game is not a permanent ranking.
JetsDST permits other allocations but two recent sacks and a turnover-free opposing QB are a weak upside foundation.
uncertainty: Actual Week8 practice/inactive and role changes; empty report render does not mean healthy.
Jets target competition, Brown goal-line split and Browns offensive limitations.
entries.lineup_effect: First complete v1 at$49,200/$800remaining; no replacements of the original four. All forecasts null because current provider covers14games; official Sunday pool remains11games.
change_triggers: Fresh availability or participation that undermines any selected role.
A source-qualified complete package offering a better allocation under cap.
Actual Claude contribution and substantive question/reply exchange; not mere delivery notice.
carry_forward: Recheck Cooper/Taylor target competition, not just their touchdowns.
Verify actual Wednesday availability for StBrown, Lamar and selected players; blank pages are not clearances.
Claude v1 request uses common inputs without Codex picks where feasible. Posting/receipt/output remain separate.
Assess bound expectations after games; preserve misses and unassessable roles. Keep S1–S5 descriptive and override delta separate.

expectations.subject: Chase Brown
expectations.statement: Retains a material rushing role with receiving involvement, without an exclusive goal-line role.
expectations.uncertainty: Perine, efficiency and distribution may reduce benefit.
expectations.challenge: Another back overtakes his opportunity or receiving work disappears.
expectations.observe: Compare RB carries, targets and red-zone touches if accessible; snaps unassessable unless inspected.

expectations.subject: Omar Cooper Jr.
expectations.statement: Remains a receiving participant with designed opportunities, but full-time route allocation is not established.
expectations.support: Five targets; attributed70%route share and primary play descriptions.
expectations.uncertainty: Mitchell, Wilson and two TEs compete; last week's efficiency is extreme.
expectations.challenge: Material reduction in participation or routes; big plays alone do not validate role.
expectations.observe: Compare actual routes/targets and receiving efficiency separately; do not mistake man-coverage subset for all routes.

expectations.subject: Mason Taylor
expectations.statement: Retains some receiving involvement at the low TE salary, without requiring repeated multi-TD scoring.
expectations.support: Six targets/five catches/62yards in the fresh Week7 box.
expectations.uncertainty: Cooper/Wilson/Sadiq compete; one game may overstate role.
expectations.challenge: Participation or targets shift substantially elsewhere.
expectations.observe: Assess targets/routes when available, and score causes separately.

expectations.subject: KC Concepcion Jr.
expectations.statement: Retains a central Browns receiving role despite a limited passing environment.
expectations.support: External report lists25/24/26%shares in prior healthy games then29%Week7.
expectations.uncertainty: Fannin/Boston competition, offense and matchup can suppress points.
expectations.challenge: Meaningful passing participation redistribution or availability change.
expectations.observe: Compare targets/teamattempts and qualified routes when available; separate yards/TD from opportunity.
